title: Necessary, Sufficient, and Sequential Conditions of Mass Atrocity Onset: A Multimethod Comparative Study
domain: genocide studies / comparative politics / conflict processes / configurational comparative methods / event history / causal inference / atrocity prevention
summary: A prevention-oriented multimethod comparative study of the conditions, combinations, sequences, and timing under which genocide, politicide, and intrastate mass killing begin. QCA is retained as one replication and configurational tool, alongside Coincidence Analysis (CNA), Necessary Condition Analysis (NCA), event-history/rare-event models, process tracing, sequence-sensitive comparison, and predictive benchmarks. A periodic-table-like condition atlas is an evidence-synthesis layer rather than a deterministic causal recipe.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C user-requested project registered 2026-09-24; reframed the same day from a QCA-centered design to a method-neutral multimethod design before empirical outcome inspection

figures.strategy: periodic-table-like condition atlas + configurational pathways + timing/onset visualization after method-specific design gates are frozen

outputs.exception: Pre-outcome design stage. No condition is labeled necessary or sufficient until replicated and sensitivity-tested.
